title: C++: Token Bucket Rate Limiter
description: Implement a token bucket rate limiter.

steps.title: Token Bucket
steps.description: Create a TokenBucket class with capacity, tokens, and fillRate. Implement bool allowRequest() that consumes a token if available (tokens refill up to capacity each call). Test 8 requests with capacity 5: first 5 allowed, next 3 denied.
hints: TokenBucket(int cap, int rate) : capacity(cap), tokens(cap), fillRate(rate) {}
bool allowRequest() { if (tokens < capacity) tokens++; if (tokens > 0) { tokens--; return true; } return false; }
